subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than
guide_solution: Summary Greenhouse effect is now a major global concern. World temperatures are increasing day by day which is a threat for our existence. The main cause is the increased amount of carbon dioxide around the earth. It is produced by the burning of fossil fuels, coal and oil. Besides, indiscriminate cutting down of trees is responsible for this. Rapid growth of industry plays a vital role to increase the amount of carbon dioxide. Trees absorb the toxic carbon dioxide gas and produce oxygen. But we are cutting down trees ignoring its disastrous consequences. So, we should stop polluting the environment with a view to controlling greenhouse effect to ensure a healthy globe.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Shaheed Bir Uttam Lt. Anwar Girls' College, Dhaka. Sl. No. 36; Page No. 87
